The '''Twitch Pokémon Marathon''' is a ten-month-long marathon of {{aniseries|PTS}} that began on August 27, 2018 at 10 AM PDT featuring the 932 episodes from the first 19 [[season]]s and 16 {{pkmn|movie}}s. The stream was broadcast simultaneously in {{pmin|the United States|English}}, {{pmin|France|French}}, {{pmin|Germany|German}}, {{pmin|Spain|Spanish}}, {{pmin|Italy|Italian}}, and {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese}} on the [https://www.twitch.tv/twitchpresents TwitchPresents] channel on [[Twitch]]. For the first run of the marathon from August 27 to October 28, blocks of 10 to 16 episodes from the [[original series]] and ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' were aired daily from Monday to Thursday. The episodes were re-aired during the day on the main channel as well as on Fridays and Saturdays on the [https://www.twitch.tv/twitchpresents2 TwitchPresents2] channel. On Sundays, a Pokémon movie was aired at 10 AM PT. The Twitch Presents: Pokémon Badge Collector extension also allowed viewers to catch various Pokémon to earn points during the stream. For the second run of the marathon from November 22 to December 2 and December 24 to January 3, episodes from the first two seasons and the third through fifth seasons aired over 11 days for each half, with a Pokémon movie shown daily exclusively on the main TwitchPresents channel. The Pokémon Badge Collector extension was not enabled. For the third run of the marathon February 27 to May 5, a showcase of episodes to promote the {{TCG|Team Up}} TCG expansion was shown on [[Pokémon Day]], February 27, followed by episodes from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'', ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', and ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'' from Thursdays to Sundays.
